paper.title: Rates of venous thromboembolism in multiple myeloma patients undergoing immunomodulatory therapy with thalidomide or lenalidomide: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

source.title: Rates of venous thromboembolism in multiple myeloma patients undergoing immunomodulatory therapy with thalidomide or lenalidomide: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

reviewMethods.design: Systematic review/meta-analysis of VTE incidence, secondary evidence
reviewMethods.selection: Prospective consecutive newlydiagnosed or previouslytreated myeloma starting thalidomide/lenalidomide regimen, VTE/majorbleeding outcomes; excludes retrospective/nonconsecutive/duplicate reports
reviewMethods.primaryOutcome: Symptomatic VTE defined/graded by NCICTC2/CTCAE3/WHO/investigator; no study VTE screening
reviewMethods.secondaryOutcome: Major bleeding, predefined but not sufficiently reported for rates
reviewMethods.synthesis: Freeman-Tukey arcsine transformed individual rates, back-transformed random-effects pooled estimates; not head-to-head RR or simple raw pooled proportions
reviewMethods.qualityTools: Cochrane risk-of-bias for regimenRCTs/Newcastle-Ottawa for observational studies; individual supporting tables not read

includedStudies.relationToPriorPackets: Title/author/prophylaxis description related to later Palumbo2011 inCAL03/04, not a separately verified newtrial

results.outcome: Secondary newlydiagnosed thalidomide/dexamethasone stratified VTE incidence
Secondary newlydiagnosed lenalidomide/dexamethasone VTE incidence by prophylaxis
Secondary previouslytreated lenalidomide and thalidomide ASA contexts with unit/regimen/timing limits

claims.statement: Newlydiagnosed thalidomide/dexamethasone pooled incidence differed across observed prophylaxis strata, but no formal causal comparison establishes aspirin benefit, optimum agent or general safety.

Newlydiagnosed lenalidomide/dexamethasone pooled ASA rate .9 versus no-prophylaxis .8 per100patientcycles comes from nonrandomized strata with different therapy/selection. It is not proof of aspirin harm, ineffectiveness, equivalence or a causal risk ratio.

Previouslytreated pooled lenalidomide rates have inconsistent prose/table time units and different background regimens; ASA-labeled pool includes mixed prophylaxis. Prior-treated thalidomide ASA timing subgroups are observational. Majorbleeding risk remains unknown, not zero.

downstreamMapping.purpose: Private secondary observational VTE prophylaxis context, no anticancer benefit/currentrecommendation/grade

sourceQualifications.description: Secondary incidence review; 71eligible articles are not independently verified trials/patients. Although15underlying trials randomized myeloma regimens, all thromboprophylaxis data were observational. No causal randomized aspirin effect or new independently verified primary trial/people.

Newlydiagnosed rates per100patientcycles versus previouslytreated per100patientmonths per methods/tableheaders. Abstract and lenalidomide results prose call previouslytreated rates patientcycles; discussion6.7doxorubicin calls cycles whileTable6/results say months. Preserve literal contradictions, use table/method labels with qualification; do not turn rates into percentages/patient risks or compare equal time units.

Regimen, steroid dose, disease stage, doxorubicin and prophylaxis timing/selection vary; no formal across-strategy/treatment comparisons possible. ASA.9versusno.8 per100cycles does not prove aspirin harm, ineffectiveness or equivalence. Lower therapeutic-anticoagulant point rate is author observation, not established optimum/prescription.

Any prophylaxis groups include agent-specific groups, not independent controls; Table5 N993versusASA80/warfarin387/LMWH446/therapeutic80, Table7N349containsASA172. Do not sum nested Ns or treat pools as separate randomized arms; denominatorpatienttime not reported for recalculation.

Thalidomide withoutdex no-prophylaxis tableCI.4to2.7 differs from adjacentbody.4to7.2, samepoint1.3. Retain unresolved literal discrepancy, no silent correction. ASA2.3CI.9to7.9/N80 copied exactly, no assumed symmetric CI.

Table6 prior-treated thalidomide/dex has ASA dagger without pooled estimate, points to one study58ASAfromstart/26duringprotocol. The3.5CI1.2to6.5/N50 entry in finalrow is WARFARIN1-1.25mg column, not ASA. Blank cells are unreported, not zero; do not assign3.5/N50toASA.

Table8previouslytreated ASA-labeled .6CI.01to2.1/N131 includes sourceTable4Knop69withASAorenoxaparinordalteparin options; ASA-only event denominators cannot be isolated. No-prophylaxis.7/N361 lenalidomide/dex differsfromASA-labeled doxorubicin-containing regimens, not like-for-like efficacy comparison.

Baz2005ASAfromstart58/4events versusduringprotocol26/11events andnone19/11events are observational groups with different timing. No causal riskratio or equal observation-window assumption; same report/subgroups not independent trials. Table6daggerdescriptiveonly.

Selected rates have substantialheterogeneity: thalidomide/dexnoneI2=75%,any34%;lenalidomideNewnone95%/ASA55%,priornone25%/ASA70%; somehigh96%. Smallstrata and nonuniformdiagnostic/grade definitions limit estimates. No reliable universal risk/benefit claim from point rates.

Results say planned quality/grading sensitivity and subgroup analyses precluded by fewstudies; discussion says quality-stratified sensitivity did not materially alter heterogeneity with data notshown. Keep discrepancy; no claimed verified sensitivity robustness.

None reported majorbleeding events is inadequate reporting, not observedzero/safety. Discussion says majorbleeding rates unknown and competingrisk/benefit unclear; no pooledbleeding rate, NNH or netbenefit can be supplied.
